text:
After consulting with the dentist following an accident that broke my front tooth in half, I came to see the dentist who explained the treatment process. It started with root canal treatment, placing a post, and preparing the tooth for a ceramic crown. From the beginning of the procedure, the dentist was very polite, gentle, and I didn't feel any anesthesia. The work was excellent, detailed, and very neat. The entire treatment took 15 days, which was faster than estimated by other places because they have their own lab for making crowns.
Therefore, I recommend this dentist to anyone who needs dental care or consultation. Importantly, the price is very good, and the staff provides excellent service.
